location: 9324 Clifford St, Suite 102, Fort Worth, TX 76108
short_description: Orange Leaf Yogurt will open a new location at Clifford Crossings in Fort Worth, with renovations expected to begin in June 2026 and a target opening of mid-August. The 1,279-square-foot store will offer frozen yogurt, shakes, and crepes, and will be the 17th Orange Leaf location in Texas and the fourth in Fort Worth. A new ice cream sandwich product is also planned to debut at the location.

Gold Palm, a restaurant and cocktail bar located at 1900 Telegraph Avenue in Oakland, will serve its last dinner on May 27, 2026, due to ongoing financial challenges. The restaurant, which opened in 2024, cited unsustainable economics as the reason for closure, noting the business performed well but not well enough to continue. The adjoining cocktail bar, Moonglow, will remain open and continue operating.

Crust Simply Italian's planned Mesa location at The Grid development in Downtown Mesa had faced construction delays but is now moving forward again. No official opening date or address has been announced. The brand currently operates locations in Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, and Peoria.

Avondale is among the Valley communities now under consideration for a future Crust Simply Italian location. No official timeline or address has been announced. The Arizona-based Italian restaurant brand is continuing to evaluate expansion opportunities across the Valley.

Surprise is among the Valley communities now under consideration for a future Crust Simply Italian location. No official timeline or address has been announced. The Arizona-based Italian restaurant brand is continuing to evaluate expansion opportunities across the Valley.

L&L Hawaiian Barbecue opened a new location on May 11, 2026, at La Costa Town Square in Carlsbad, marking the brand's 100th location in California. The location is owned by franchisee Chloe Tran and serves Hawaiian plate lunches including BBQ Mix, Chicken Katsu, Kalua Pork, Loco Moco, and Garlic Shrimp. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, mobile-app ordering, third-party delivery, and catering services.

location: 9325 JW Clay Blvd, Suite 211, Charlotte, NC 28262
short_description: A new Palm Berries location is preparing to open near Charlotte's university area, marking the franchise owner's third location. The health-focused concept offers acai bowls, smoothies, and fresh-cut fruit, with an emphasis on speed and hospitality. Further opening details are expected to be announced closer to launch.

location: 606 Broadway E., Seattle, WA (zip not specified)
short_description: Bait Shop, a Capitol Hill bar operating at its Broadway address since 2012, is being forced to relocate due to planned demolition and redevelopment of its building. No new address or timeline has been finalized, though co-owners hope to remain on Capitol Hill. The lack of a firm landlord timeline has made planning difficult.

Franchisees Jeff and Becky Montie, along with Robbin and Jimmy McCullen, are expanding Palm Berries across North Carolina. The first confirmed location at Quail Corners in south Charlotte is targeting a mid-June opening.

location: 16631 Lancaster Highway, Ballantyne, Charlotte, NC (zip not specified)
status: hope to open this unit by late summer
short_description: Part of the same multi-location franchise expansion by the Montie and McCullen families, the Ballantyne location is the second planned opening. The group is targeting late summer for this unit.
A third Palm Berries location is in the works for Winston-Salem, with the team nearing a signed lease agreement. No address or opening date has been confirmed.

James Beard Award winners Jody Williams and Rita Sodi are opening a second location of their Bar Pisellino café inside the Flatiron Building. Construction is set to begin in summer 2026, with the restaurant expected to open in 2027. The all-day concept will offer light fare, a full coffee program, and a full bar.

Wagyu House is planning its first Arizona location at Chandler Fashion Center, occupying the former Kona Grill space. The all-you-can-eat yakiniku concept specializes in premium Wagyu beef and is operated by Chubby Group. An exact opening date has not been announced but a 2027 debut is expected.

location: 20409 State Hwy 46 W, Suite 108, Bulverde, TX 78163
short_description: A new Tropical Smoothie Cafe franchise is planned for Spring Branch in Comal County, with construction expected to begin May 15, 2026. The 1,382-square-foot space will undergo a first-time tenant improvement buildout estimated at $175,000. Franchise owner Farhan Hyder confirmed the upcoming location to WhatNow San Antonio.

Carbonara, an Italian restaurant with an existing Arlington location, is opening its second location in Gainesville in the former Bar Louie space. Chef Mike Cordero anticipates the restaurant will be customer-ready in July and will accommodate around 250 guests. The Gainesville location will be significantly larger than its Arlington counterpart.

Miami-born Cuban bakery and cafe Pinecrest Bakery is planning a Miami Lakes location, listed as "coming soon" on its website. The brand operates more than 30 locations throughout South Florida, with most open 24 hours a day. No opening date has been announced.

location: 33 Town Square Blvd., Suite 130, Asheville, NC (zip not specified)
short_description: Palm Berries is preparing to open a new corporate-owned location in Asheville, with co-founder Chandler Gottlieb stating the restaurant is expected to open May 30. The fruit-forward bowls and smoothies brand is expanding across North Carolina. The Asheville opening is one of two upcoming corporate locations alongside a South Charlotte restaurant.

location: 7808 Rea Rd., Suite E, Charlotte, NC (zip not specified)
short_description: Palm Berries is also planning a second new corporate-owned location on Rea Road in South Charlotte, targeting a June 6 opening. Co-founder Chandler Gottlieb said the two openings could set the stage for additional growth throughout North Carolina. The company has focused on operational efficiency and supply chain logistics to support its expansion.

location: 3220 W. Bell Rd, Phoenix, AZ (zip not specified) — current food truck location; permanent location not yet identified
short_description: Bikini Q BBQ, currently operating as a food truck in Phoenix, is targeting an early 2027 opening for its first brick-and-mortar restaurant. Founder Veronica Hansen told WhatNow Phoenix the long-term vision is for the concept to remain drive-thru focused. No permanent location has been identified yet.

status: hoping to be open within the first week of June
short_description: Bollywood Masala is relocating from its 10-year home at 120 Rosewick Road in La Plata to a new storefront at 3804 Crain Highway in Waldorf. Owners Rajat and Punita Malhotra are continuing operations during the move and plan to expand their menu with new specials and cocktails. Rajat stated inspections are nearly complete and an opening is expected within the first week of June.

location: 3300 N University Dr, Coral Springs, FL 33065
status: opening date has not been announced
short_description: Pilar Coffee Bar has filed permit applications to open a location at 3300 University Drive in Coral Springs. The boutique coffee shop and bistro announced plans to open 11 new franchised locations by end of 2027. No opening date for the Coral Springs location has been announced.

The Boston Licensing Board approved plans for restaurateurs Steve Bisson and Jack Sullivan to transform the current French Quarter space at 545 Washington St into a new Garden of Eden-inspired restaurant and cocktail bar called Seven. The 90-seat venue will feature a cocktail program centered around the seven deadly sins and an immersive biblical-themed atmosphere. A timeline for the transition has not yet been announced.

status: hoping to introduce his second restaurant on June 20
short_description: Sassy Mac Boys, a mac and cheese concept that started as a food truck in 2023, is working on a second location at CherryVale Mall in Rockford following its first brick-and-mortar debut in Machesney Park. Owner Donald Czyzyk is targeting a June 20 opening and plans to expand via a franchise model throughout Illinois. No lease deals for additional locations have been signed yet.

status: on track to begin greeting guests in early August
short_description: Walk-On's Sports Bistreaux is under construction at 2809 E. Highland Drive in Jonesboro, the former site of Ryan's Buffet. Franchisee Chris McJunkins says the 6,500-square-foot building represents a newer prototype with an open floor plan and semi-enclosed patio. The restaurant is set to open before summer's end, with early August as the target.

location: 75 John Wesley Dobbs Ave NE, Suite 100, Atlanta, GA 30303
short_description: Urban Tea Party, a local loose leaf tea brand helmed by Sherolyn Sellers, is heading to Studio House Atlanta as part of a group of local pop-ups planned prior to the World Cup. The duration of the pop-up is unclear, though longer residencies appear possible. What Now Atlanta reached out for additional details but had not received a response prior to publication.

status: expected to open in late summer
short_description: Bayt Al Mocha, a Michigan-based Yemeni coffee franchise, is opening its first California location inside the Greenback Corners shopping center in Sacramento. Operator Rayna Al-Shaybani confirmed the roughly 1,500-square-foot café, which will include a patio, to What Now Sacramento. The brand already operates locations across several states including Michigan, Virginia, Georgia, and New York.

location: 45 Auto Center Dr, Foothill Ranch, CA 92610
short_description: Elio California, a specialty coffee brand, may be preparing to open a coffee shop at 45 Auto Center Drive in Foothill Ranch, based on a plan review filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency. No specific opening timeline has been disclosed. The brand specializes in single-origin coffees, handcrafted beverages, and also offers chai drinks and a subscription service.

location: 357 Sam Ridley Pkwy W, Smyrna, TN 37167
status: expected to open; further details not yet announced
short_description: Dave's Hot Chicken is planning a new restaurant in Smyrna, Tennessee, led by franchisees Jason and John Hotchkiss as part of a broader Middle Tennessee expansion. Additional locations are reportedly planned for Murfreesboro and Mount Juliet. No projected debut timeline for the Smyrna location has been announced.

Firehouse Subs announced a multi-unit franchise agreement with local entrepreneur William Ellis to open new locations across San Antonio. The first location under the new agreement is expected to open in summer 2026 at 1375 S Main St in Boerne. The deal is part of a broader plan contributing to more than 130 Firehouse Subs restaurants across Texas.

status: expecting to open in the fall
short_description: Marseille-inspired restaurant Massilia is opening a new Santa Monica location at 2820-2826 Main St., with owner Emmanuel Dossetti confirming the team expects to open in the fall. The restaurant formerly had a Santa Monica location on Fourth Street that shuttered at the end of 2025. The all-day restaurant draws on French, Spanish, Italian, and North African cuisine.

The Scoop N Scootery, an ice cream concept known for extravagant sundaes, is set to make its South Carolina debut at 2414 Devine St. in Columbia this summer. Franchise owner Emmett Morrison is targeting an August opening and plans to offer both indoor and outdoor seating, differentiating it from the brand's typical takeout/delivery model. The brand was founded in Massachusetts in 2014 and has grown to eight locations.

Puff Coffee is preparing to open its second Portland location in July at 3356 S.E. Belmont St., a space historically associated with Stumptown Coffee Roasters. The café was founded by Duane Sorenson, who originally founded Stumptown Coffee Roasters, and launched Puff Coffee's first cafe in 2022 at 2816 S.E. Stark Street. Additional details about the new cafe's menu and design have not yet been announced.

status: preparing to open later this year
short_description: Texas de Brazil is opening a location at The Orchard Town Center in Westminster, Colorado, as part of a wave of new food and beverage concepts arriving at the outdoor lifestyle mall later this summer. The family-owned Brazilian steakhouse, founded in 1998, operates over 55 restaurants in 23 states. No specific opening date has been announced.
